verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's docs say it schedules daily default backups automatically and lets users create, schedule, and restore backups themselves. Self-serve restores are documented through restore-to-branch and point-in-time `--restore-point` in the CLI, and backup success or failure events add visibility. missing for 10: detailed documentation of schedule configuration options (frequency, retention) and how the schedule is viewed, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of backup and restore.

support.subject: As a founder, automatic backups run on a schedule I can see and configure, and restores are self-serve

citations.quote: PlanetScale provides the ability to create, schedule, and restore backups for production and development database branches.
In addition to the daily default backups that PlanetScale schedules for your database branches, you can create additional manual backups.
You can now create a PostgreSQL branch restored to a point-in-time timestamp with --restore-point.
We've added backup.succeeded and backup.failed webhook events.
